name: brainstem
description: Permission-scoped engineering agents with bounded repository evidence and durable workflow gates.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve focused context and run evidence-gated workflows.
interface.longDescription: Brainstem keeps repository context small and makes design, tests, verification, and review durable across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Use Brainstem to retrieve the smallest relevant context and start an evidence-gated workflow for this task.
